story: The hero-prince is sent into exile by a queen mother who wants her own son to inherit the throne. His faithful wife joins him, having been won when he alone succeeded in a challenge of firing arrows through a spinning wheel. His younger brother also joins them out of concern. In the forest, a female demon tries to seduce first the prince, then his brother, who cuts off her ear and nose in anger. She flees to her ten-headed brother, a demon king ruling an island, who travels to the forest with his uncle. Awed by the wife's beauty, the demon king has his uncle transform into a golden deer to lure the brothers away, then imitates the prince's voice to draw the brother off too, despite a protective magic circle drawn around the wife. Disguised as an old beggar, the demon king tricks her outside the circle and abducts her. The brothers ally with a monkey king, helping him defeat a rival, and in gratitude the monkey king sends a monkey warrior to help search for the wife, discovering she is held on the demon's island. The monkey warrior orders a bridge built to the island; mermaids sabotage the work, but he falls in love with their princess, who then stops interfering. The prince and demon king battle; only by piercing the demon's navel is he finally slain. The prince returns triumphant but suspects his wife's fidelity after a magical incident with a portrait. She passes a trial by fire but, hurt by his distrust, leaves to live with a wiseman, bearing twin sons who are later reunited with their father.
